subject: Proofs for renewal meeting — throughput and failover evidence
messages:
From: Sam Park <sam.park@opsly.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal evidence request — throughput + failover

Hi Rachel,

We have an exec review next Thursday where procurement + engineering will sign off on the renewal for Opsly. Before that meeting we need short, focused evidence on two things:

1) Sustained throughput at 200 tokens/sec (p95) for our common prompt mix (sample attached).
2) Failover behavior across regions — we need a short description and any logs that show automated fallback and latency impact.

Can Redwood run a quick, targeted proof (no full bench) and share results and a short one-pager that we can slot into the deck? Ideally delivered by EOD tomorrow. Procurement also wants to see proposed term adjustments if we commit to a 12-month reserved capacity uplift.

We'd like the benchmark csv filled with the run details — I attached the template. If this is too tight, call me and we'll shift the review.

Thanks,
Sam Park
Head of Platform Engineering | Opsly
Sam.Park@opsly.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: opsly-benchmark-request.csv
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@opsly.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal evidence request — throughput + failover

Sam — thanks for the clear ask and the template. We can do this. Quick plan below:

- Run a focused 2-hour sustained run against a pinned model variant with your prompt mix (we'll use the short/long mix in the CSV).
- Provide a p95 latency and tokens/sec summary, plus a short failover test that simulates losing us-west and routing to us-east (we'll include a trace-level timeline).
- Deliverables: filled CSV, a 1-page summary PNG, and a short write-up of routing/fallback behavior + suggested term adjustment for a committed uplift.

We have a couple of questions before we start:
- Which model family/size are you validating against? If you want us to mirror production traffic exactly, please confirm the model name in the CSV — otherwise we'll run on the Redwood-verified model that best matches your RT profile and call it out.
- Are you okay with us redacting any customer PII from logs? We will not include raw customer prompts in the public deliverable.

Karthik & Logan — looped you both for ops support: can you spin the test harness and provide a minimal redline for a 12-month uplift (targets: 30% capacity increase, 10% unit discount at commit)? I'll prepare the one-pager and a draft term sheet to share with Procurement.

I'll aim to have the first artifacts by 20:00 PT tomorrow. If we need to move faster, I'll call.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: provisioning-plan.pdf (stub)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal evidence request — throughput + failover (internal)

Karthik / Logan — quick execution checklist:

1) Test harness: use the short/long prompt mix from Sam's CSV. Run two 1-hour sustained phases: baseline (no cache), steady-state (with prefix caching). Capture p50/p90/p95 token/sec and CPU/GPU utilization.
2) Failover sim: during the steady-state phase, trigger a simulated us-west AZ outage (kill route) and measure p95 impact and time-to-failover. Collect routing traces and KV cache hit-rate before/after.
3) Artifacts: filled CSV, a 1-page summary (PNG), and a short log excerpt (sanitize PII). Also produce a proposed term bullet sheet: +30% capacity, 10% unit discount, 60-day ramp. Attach redlined terms (v2) for legal to look at if Opsly pushes faster.

Notes: if we hit any performance delta >20% vs Redwood baseline, we'll prepare an ops mitigation plan (small quantization tweak + alternative kernel) and flag it to Rachel for the customer-facing note.

Can you commit to producing the CSV and PNG by 20:00 PT? I'm coordinating with Rachel on the draft term bullets for Procurement.

Thanks — Karthik, please take the harness; Logan, capture routing traces.

-Rachel

Attachment: redlined-terms-v2.docx (internal stub)
From: Marta Iglesias <marta.iglesias@opsly.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Park <sam.park@opsly.com>, Procurement <procurement@opsly.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal evidence request — throughput + failover

Rachel — this is perfect. Thanks for the quick internal note and the proposed terms. We confirm: run on the Redwood-verified model if you need to default; redaction ok. Procurement wants a short term bullet list they can include in the contract (we'll accept a draft for now).

Also please include an editable DocuSign link or a simple term sheet (Word/PDF) we can push to legal. We aim to discuss in the exec review at 15:00 PT tomorrow. If you can get the CSV + one-pager by EOD today that's ideal.

Thanks,
Marta Iglesias
Director, Procurement | Opsly
marta.iglesias@opsly.com

Attachment: opsly-rfp-scoring-template.xlsx
